title: MRI and pathology model predicts TACE combination therapy response in liver cancer
summary: IMPRESS combines pretreatment MRI habitat radiomics, biopsy whole-slide image pathomics and clinical features to predict response to TACE plus targeted therapy and immunotherapy in 231 unresectable HCC patients, of whom 94 (40.7%) responded. AUC was 0.957 in training, 0.878 in validation and 0.875 in test cohorts, and predicted groups differed in overall survival. The study is multicenter and retrospective.
ai_technology: Habitat MRI radiomics and whole-slide image pathomics deep learning integrated model
